factual_errors.text: A complete loop with a source of potential difference is a <dfn>closed circuit</dfn>.
factual_errors.correction: A closed circuit is any complete loop. Including a source of potential difference is the extra condition needed for charge to flow through it. It is not part of the definition of a closed circuit. The spec wording separates the two: "For electrical charge to flow through a closed circuit the circuit must include a source of potential difference."

factual_errors.text: A complete loop that includes a source of potential difference, such as a cell, so charge can flow.
factual_errors.correction: A closed circuit is a complete loop. For charge to flow through a closed circuit, the circuit must also include a source of potential difference. The source is a condition for flow, not part of the definition.
